name: Diamond Biotechnology Co., Ltd
summary: Diamond Biotechnology Co., Ltd is a company focused on the entire lifecycle of medical equipment and skincare products, from research and development to manufacturing and sales. Operating both domestically within Taiwan and across international markets, the firm's beauty care offerings include well-known lines such as Timera and Diamond Beauty. In addition to its core product activities, the company also provides leasing services for medical apparatus. Diamond Biotechnology was established in 2014 and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
